title: Billie Eilish's $20,000 donation helps plant 150 trees in Texas; 85% survive months later
summary_full: Billie Eilish's generous donation of $20,000 has kickstarted a vibrant woodland project in Austin's Zilker Park. This initiative involved planting 150 native trees aimed at revitalizing the local ecosystem and enhancing stormwater management. Thanks to dedicated volunteers, the newly established grove boasts an impressive survival rate of 85% for the trees.
